sandbag_stock.source: Scenario assumption for this benchmark (not a city figure). Every model gets the same stock.

levee_bags_per_100_ft.source: USACE sandbag levee guidance, 1 ft high pyramid levee: 600 bags per 100 linear feet (USACE Northwestern Division pamphlet as reproduced by Carbon Cliff IL, https://carboncliff.gov/documents/212/Sandbagging_Techniques_Pamphlet.pdf; USACE Alaska District brochure, https://juneau.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/ACOE-EOC_Sandbag_brochure.pdf). Retrieved 2026-10-25.

height_scaling.source: Assumption: a pyramid levee's base widens with height, so cross-section and bag count scale with height squared from the 1 ft figure.

doorway_protection.source: Assumption: two 1.5 m doorways per structure sandbagged 2 ft high, priced with the levee rule. Water against the building below 0.6 m causes no damage; above it, the full depth-damage curve applies.

placement_labor.source: Assumption: separate contractor crews place sandbags before the storm; the two drain crews keep their 30-minute budget.
